summary: 1933 Minnesota Forest Service steel tower; 2003 county note says its cab was removed and it was used as an ARMER radio site. FFLA lists it gone. No source describes the site today.

facts.design: 100-foot steel stairway tower; the county list names Aermotor and a square cab (cab later removed)
facts.status_note: FFLA lists it gone, but the St. Louis County list's 2003 note says it was in use as a communications site with the cab removed

notes_for_editor: Record says gone; the county list's 2003 note says otherwise, so the status needs a current check before publishing (site visit or current imagery). The St. Louis County list has a footnote 'Owned by private party. Not accessible to the public.' near the Mirror Lake row, but the layout does not show which row it belongs to, so it was not used. 'On retain list' is not explained in the source. Access is unknown. Date conflict: the 2003 note calls the tower an ARMER site, but the DPS page says ARMER was first built in 2004; the story flags this and the note's date or wording needs checking before publishing.
